publications_result_shape.name: publications_result_shape
publications_result_shape.value:
("publications"."status" = 'published' and "publications"."published_at" is not null and "publications"."failure_json" is null)
        or ("publications"."status" = 'failed' and "publications"."published_at" is null and "publications"."failure_json" is not null)

route_ingestions_completion_shape.name: route_ingestions_completion_shape
route_ingestions_completion_shape.value:
("route_ingestions"."status" = 'running' and "route_ingestions"."completed_at" is null)
        or ("route_ingestions"."status" in ('succeeded', 'failed') and "route_ingestions"."completed_at" is not null)

template_slots_kind_shape.name: template_slots_kind_shape
template_slots_kind_shape.value:
(
        ("template_slots"."kind" = 'static' and "template_slots"."path_position" is not null and "template_slots"."static_value" is not null)
        or ("template_slots"."kind" = 'variable' and "template_slots"."path_position" is not null and "template_slots"."static_value" is null)
        or ("template_slots"."kind" = 'derived' and "template_slots"."path_position" is null and "template_slots"."static_value" is null)
      )

variant_operations_valid_payload.name: variant_operations_valid_payload
variant_operations_valid_payload.value:
("variant_operations"."operation_kind" = 'set' and "variant_operations"."block_version_id" is not null and "variant_operations"."order_index" is null)
        or ("variant_operations"."operation_kind" = 'tombstone' and "variant_operations"."block_version_id" is null and "variant_operations"."order_index" is null)
        or ("variant_operations"."operation_kind" = 'order' and "variant_operations"."block_version_id" is null and "variant_operations"."order_index" >= 0)
